goals: Keep accepted C8's Inventory Extended player-storage, Clutter No More ShapeMap, vanilla shelf, Inventory Search, and CSR reservation-affinity behavior unchanged.

Admit a normally valid nearby container at QSN's real discovery prefilter when CSR reports an empty physical slot reserved for an exact source item and complete component identity, even when the container has zero physical instances of that item.

Keep Quick Stack Nearby responsible for discovery, target order, existing-stack merges, access and placement checks, capacity, remainders, rules, persistence, packets, and feedback; delegate unchanged when CSR is absent or a target has no reservation-governed empty slot.
Preserve exact prior accepted C6 as rollback and distinct runtime-passed C4 as historical provenance with immutable artifact, source, and evidence boundaries.
scope: Maintain the production implementation and resources at checkpoint 1f545721658cce803200fa277737052cead79b70 while preserving all accepted C6 behavior and retained C7 insertion behavior outside the failed discovery seam.

Wrap QSN 0.4.0's exact QuickStackMoveEngine.acceptedTypes(Container) call inside scanContainer after native access and validity checks but before nearbyTargets discards an empty accepted-types set, using only CSR's public read-only exact reservation classifier.

Scope the real source container, source window, locks, and keep-count rules around QSN's native quickStack call so reservation-only affinity is derived from movable source items and is restored without leakage after nested or exceptional calls.

Preserve existing native target set identity when no new key is needed, avoid duplicate keys and targets, and retain reservation-only targets at their natural raw-discovery and distance-sorted position rather than globally appending them.

Intercept QSN 0.4.0's exact post-merge empty-slot seam only when an empty slot is governed by a matching or mismatched reservation; insert into matching reserved empties in physical order, then ordinary empties in physical order, while mismatched reserved empties remain protected.
Preserve exact no-op identity when CSR is absent and delegate QSN's native empty-slot helper for unsupported or wholly unreserved targets.

Retain C6's Inventory Extended source-window expansion and lock ceiling, Clutter No More ShapeMap affinity and merge delegation, vanilla shelf exclusion, and Inventory Search button/result compatibility.
Audit exact QSN 0.4.0 and CSR C1 bytecode/API seams, exercise the CSR C1 API floor and paired CSR Canary 4 provider, and keep runtime metadata predicates flexible for compatible providers.
Retain exact prior accepted C6 as rollback, exact C4 as distinct historical focused-runtime-pass provenance, and failed C5 and C7 results textually rather than as current or rollback artifacts.

Preserve the exact user-bound C7 RUNTIME_FAIL with no passed rows: its post-discovery target augmentation did not admit a nearby container whose only matching affinity was a reservation and which held zero physical instances of that item.

exclusions: Container Slot Reservations, Carried Container Auto-Routing, Matcha × Stack to Nearby Chests Compatibility, Inventory Search, Block Geometry Extensions, Nibaru, Clutter No More, Quick Stack Nearby, and every other nearby-routing or inventory project retain their own identities, source, artifacts, controls, and behavior ownership.

No CSR reservation mutation, persistence, user interface, container-support policy, or classification logic is reimplemented; C8 consumes only CSR's public read-only reservation API when the provider is loaded.

No Stack to Nearby Chests implementation, Matcha-specific QSN adapter, general Inventory Search patch, carried-container routing, nested-container routing, registry-name parsing, fuzzy material equivalence, item conversion, or custom existing-stack merge is owned here.
Official QSN, CSR, Inventory Search/Core, Inventory Extended, Clutter No More, BGE, Nibaru, Minecraft, and Fabric classes or JARs are not bundled or redistributed by this project.

C8 mirrors the exact audited QSN 0.4.0 package-private maximum-stack helper through its current Container#getMaxStackSize delegate because attempted Java-package and Mixin invokers were not runtime-safe; a future QSN helper change requires seam re-audit.
Controlled JUnit and Fabric GameTest results are build/static evidence, not Minecraft gameplay runtime validation.

Lifecycle is ACCEPTED because exact current C8 was promoted into accepted Stack v17 and no longer occupies a Test Slot; C6 is rollback, C4 remains distinct historical passing provenance, and C7's independent failure remains separate.

C8 has controlled validation and exact serialized deployment/promotion evidence. The user's later combined CSR/QSN report was recorded only as an aggregate C8 PASS with no inferred row-level observations; the earlier narrow zero-physical-quantity observation remains preserved in history, and the protected gameplay instance remained untouched.
